Good place for relaxing
Feb 2023 • Couples
I recently visited Saigon Sky Bar and had a truly unforgettable experience. The view of the city from the top is absolutely breathtaking - it's easily one of the most beautiful spots in Saigon. The atmosphere was chic and stylish, and the service was impeccable. The cocktails were creative and expertly crafted, with a great variety to choose from. The bar staff was very friendly and attentive, making for a comfortable and enjoyable evening. I highly recommend visiting Saigon Sky Bar - it's a perfect place for a night out or a special occasion, and the views are truly unbeatable. A must-visit spot in Saigon

Great bar with an even better view!
Dec 2016 • Solo
The bar sits on the 9th floor of the Vietnam Inn hostel. Its a great place to meet people with lots of different things to eat and drink on the menu. It hosts Vietnam Inns famous nightly events such as the ladies night and limbo party. This bar has live sports shown and is a great place to party. And because its on the top floor of the biggest hostel In HCMC you have an amazing view of the beautiful Saigon city centre skyline!

Unbelievable Views of Saigon
Nov 2016 • Solo
This is probably the cheapest rooftop bar in Saigon. Beer is as cheap as 30k and you can get 2-4-1 with a pub crawl vest. There are drinking games and a DJ.
